name: CTCLoss

log_probs.description: Log probabilities of shape (T, N, C) or (T, C). Supports float32, float16, bfloat16. Optional fill: 'inf', '-inf', 'nan', 'zero'.

targets.description: Target sequences of shape (N, S) or (S,). dtype int64 or int32. Values exclude blank label.

zero_infinity.description: bool, whether to zero infinite losses. Default false.

loss.description: CTC loss tensor. Scalar if reduction='mean'/'sum', else (N,) or (). Here reduction='none'.

reference:
import torch

def run(log_probs, targets, blank=0, zero_infinity=False):
    T = log_probs.shape[0]
    N = 1 if log_probs.dim() == 2 else log_probs.shape[1]
    S = targets.shape[-1]
    input_lengths = torch.full((N,), T, dtype=torch.int64, device=log_probs.device)
    target_lengths = torch.full((N,), min(S, T // 2), dtype=torch.int64, device=log_probs.device)
    if log_probs.dim() == 2:
        input_lengths = input_lengths.squeeze(0)
        target_lengths = target_lengths.squeeze(0)
    return torch.nn.functional.ctc_loss(
        log_probs, targets, input_lengths, target_lengths,
        blank=blank, reduction='none', zero_infinity=zero_infinity
    )
description:
CTCLoss: Connectionist Temporal Classification loss.

torch.nn.functional.ctc_loss = ctc_loss(log_probs, targets, input_lengths, target_lengths, blank=0, reduction='mean', zero_infinity=False) -> Tensor

Args:
    log_probs (Tensor): (T, N, C) or (T, C), log-probabilities after log_softmax.
    targets (Tensor): (N, S) or (S,), target sequences excluding blank.
    input_lengths (Tensor): (N,) or (), lengths of input sequences.
    target_lengths (Tensor): (N,) or (), lengths of target sequences.
    blank (int): blank label. Default 0.
    zero_infinity (bool): zero infinite losses. Default False.

Returns: Tensor, CTC loss.
